Kipferl 0.8.0 updates the embedded PocketPy interpreter from 2.1.3 to 2.2.0,
moves tracebacks to stderr, and closes memory-safety holes that scripts could
reach. Some output changes, so check the first section before upgrading.

## What changes for existing scripts

- **Floats print with full round-trip precision**, as in CPython:
  `print(0.1 + 0.2)` prints `0.30000000000000004` instead of `0.3`, and
  `json.dumps` and f-strings follow. Compare output against CPython rather than
  against earlier Kipferl releases.
- **`math.floor`, `math.ceil` and `math.trunc` return `int`** instead of
  `float`; NaN, infinities and values beyond 64-bit integers raise
  `ValueError`. `math.isinf`, `math.isnan` and `math.isfinite` return `bool`.
  `int(x)` and `round(x)` raise `ValueError` for the same values instead of
  returning an arbitrary number.
- **Tracebacks go to stderr.** An uncaught exception prints its traceback on
  stderr, as CPython does; the exit status is still 1 and stdout holds only
  what the program printed. This applies to `kipferl run`, `dev`, `test` and
  built applications. If you parsed tracebacks from stdout, read stderr
  instead, for example with `2>&1`. Kipferl's internal startup and module
  loader frames no longer appear in tracebacks.
- **Removed undocumented modules.** PocketPy's `linalg` and `colorcvt` modules
  are gone upstream, and `pkpy.TValue` is no longer available.
- The `kipferl new` starters print their errors on stderr. Projects you already
  generated keep their code.

## New

- `%`-formatting of tuples (`"%s %r" % (a, b)`), `bool` arithmetic,
  `str.splitlines`, iteration over `bytes`, `bin()`, `dict.popitem()`, signed
  `str.zfill`, `inspect.signature`, `typing.override`, `typing.TypeGuard` and
  `typing.TypeIs`.
- `NO_COLOR` support: Kipferl's own CLI output is styled only on a terminal, and
  `NO_COLOR` set to a non-empty value turns styling off; `CLICOLOR_FORCE` and
  `FORCE_COLOR` turn it on for pipes. `tui` and `input` add no colours of their
  own under `NO_COLOR`.
- `input.prompt`, `password`, `select`, `multiselect` and `confirm` finish when
  their input ends instead of spinning at full CPU, for example in CI, cron or
  `ssh` without `-t`.

## Security

This release fixes memory-safety issues that a script could trigger: oversized
allocations such as `'a' * (2**32 + 1)` or a huge `array2d` grid, objects
forged through internal types, C methods called on a receiver of the wrong
type, unvalidated `pickle.loads` input, and undefined integer and float
conversions. A garbage-collection crash while caught exceptions were still
referenced is fixed too. Affected operations now raise `ValueError` or
`TypeError`. All script test suites now also run under sanitizers in CI.

Most of these issues also affect 0.7.x and earlier releases. They matter when
you run scripts or load pickles that you did not write. `pickle.loads` now
rejects malformed data, but as in CPython a pickle can still call functions:
use it only for trusted data.

Standalone applications embed their runtime. Applications built with an earlier
release keep the old runtime and these issues: rebuild and redistribute them
with 0.8.0 to give them the fixes. Applications built with `--mode executable`
or `--mode single` run on the `pocketpy-kipferl` runtime found on `PATH`, so
update that runtime wherever they run.

## Package evidence

`kipferl deps verified` lists only `tzdata`, re-tested against this release's
own runtime on each platform. Other workflows on the package guide, such as
`trove-classifiers`, were tested against earlier runtimes and still need the
`--allow-unverified` command shown on their cards.

## Upgrade

Run `brew update && brew upgrade kipferl`, or download your platform's binary
and verify its adjacent checksum. `kipferl --version` reports `Kipferl v0.8.0`.

The embedded runtime changed, so runtime-bound dependency locks need a refresh:
rerun `kipferl add` for your declared requirements, review and commit the lock,
then run your application tests. Never edit hashes to bypass a mismatch.

Upgrade guide: https://kipferl.dev/docs/guides/packages#upgrade-to-080

Package evidence: https://kipferl.dev/docs/guides/package-audit
